verdict.rationale: The evidence implies each incident has a timeline: AI-drafted retrospectives analyze "the incident's timeline" and include timelines in the draft. The Scribe captures discussions and decisions on meeting bridges, and `/fh update` notes are posted to the incident. However, no documentation describes automatic capture of alerts, runbook actions and Slack chat into that timeline, or editing and annotating timeline entries afterwards. Retrospective editing is only adjacent. missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic timeline capture of alerts/actions/Slack chat, documented ability to edit or annotate timeline entries after the fact, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the incident timeline is captured automatically — alerts, actions, and chat decisions — and I can edit or annotate it afterwards

citations.quote: Analyze the incident's timeline, details, and context
AI-Drafted Retrospectives generate a comprehensive draft that includes a structured overview of the incident, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned.
the FireHydrant Scribe will be invited to your meetings to capture crucial discussions and decisions made during incident bridges
All incident notes/updates posted via Slack (`/fh update`) or via Command Center are posted to the Internal Status Page
